**How to read a lane**

- **Database** = schema / migration / seed / query foundation (MSSQL).
- **Web API** = New-API (.NET 8) HTTP endpoints for clinic web / admin / account (and shared contracts). Login remains on Old-API until formal cut-over.
- **API Mobile** = same New-API (or dedicated mobile-facing controllers) that the **Patient app / Doctor mobile** wire to — often “Wire to Phase 8–15 API for: …” under M17/M18.

**Progress reality check:** S1 Web API + Database foundation are largely **Done** (53). Almost all of S2–S5 for these three lanes is still **Not Started**. API Mobile is **0 Done** (1 In Progress: `DMO-08.02`).

## 3. Architecture rules & reusable building blocks

Build **once**, reuse across Web API + API Mobile + Database consumers.

### 3.1 Hard rules

| Rule | Detail |
|---|---|
| Dual-API | New features on **New-API** (.NET 8). Old-API only for Login (and legacy Rx/Razorpay until moved). |
| Shared keys | PatientId, PatientAppId, DoctorId, Appointment/Payment IDs must match across web + mobile. |
| Auth | JWT with Role + DoctorId/PatientId claims; ownership checks on every mutating clinical/money call. |
| OTP | One generic `RequestOtp` / `VerifyOtp` (+ audit) — Patient login, booking, caregiver, etc. reuse it. |
| Consent | One `ConsentRecord` model — do not fork second consent tables for tele/pharmacy/privacy. |
| Money | `PaymentOrder` + stream (`CONSULT`/`SUBSCRIPTION`/`MEDICINE`); **never** reuse PackageEntryDetail for consult pay. |
| Files | `SecureDocument` + authorised GET — no public directory browsing. |
| Audit | `AuditEvent` middleware/helper on money/Rx/approval mutations. |
| Mobile vs Web API | Prefer **same endpoints** with role-aware DTOs; only split when payload/auth truly differs. |
| Status tracking | Edit yellow Status only on week sheets; modules/S03/dashboards are live-linked. |

### 3.2 Reusable capability map (build these as shared packages)

| Capability | Primary tickets | Reused by |
|---|---|---|
| Auth + Logout + menu-by-role | SEC-01…SEC-04 | All portals + mobile session |
| OTP engine | SEC-07.* | Patient auth, booking, caregiver, pay links |
| Consent centre | SEC-06.* | Tele recording, pharmacy share, privacy, booking |
| Secure documents | SEC-09.* | Trust docs, eRx PDFs, support attachments |
| Family + caregiver | CON-01/02 | Web continuity + Patient app |
| Appointment core | APT-* | Reception, tele, patient booking, payments |
| PaymentOrder / webhook | PAY-* | Consult, subscription, medicine |
| Ledger / settlement | FIN-* | Account portal, doctor payouts |
| eRx snapshot | ERX-* | Pharmacy, patient records, refill |
| Notifications | COM-* | SMS/WhatsApp/push/email for all apps |

### 3.3 Suggested implementation order (Overall)

1. **Finish any open S1 gaps / UAT** on security + family (already mostly Done).
2. **S2 Database “no-schema / index / DTO” tickets** in parallel with **S2 Web API** clinical + patient-website read APIs.
3. **S3** appointments + reception + tele + support schema → APIs (mobile booking depends on these).
4. **S4** money spine (PAY/FIN) + trust + eRx + HomeoMeds — highest coupling; Database first, then Web API, then API Mobile wires.
5. **S5** communications + reports + remaining mobile wires.
6. Throughout: for every Web API that Patient/Doctor apps need, land the **API Mobile wire ticket** in the same sprint or immediately after contract freeze.

## 4. PART A — Overall plan

### 4.1 Goal

Deliver a production-ready **data + API backbone** so Clinic Web, Account, Patient app, and Doctor mobile share one truth for identity, appointments, clinical artifacts, payments, and pharmacy — without duplicating tables or endpoint families.

### 4.2 Workstreams (parallel)

| Stream | Owns | Cadence |
|---|---|---|
| **DB** | MSSQL scripts, indexes, seeds, backfills | Ahead of API by ~0.5–1 day per feature |
| **Web API** | New-API controllers/services/DTOs for web portals | After DB contract freeze |
| **API Mobile** | Mobile-facing routes or thin adapters + contract tests | After Web API contract stable |
| **Contract** | OpenAPI samples, shared IDs, error codes | Same PR as API |

### 4.4 Overall milestone checklist

- [ ] All **Database** tickets either executed (script in repo) or marked N/A with written “reuse verified”.
- [ ] All **Web API** tickets have Swagger-tested endpoints + ownership/role checks.
- [ ] All **API Mobile** wire tickets have Postman/app calls against the same contracts.
- [ ] Money/tele/eRx flows audited + consent-gated.
- [ ] No plaintext secrets; no public attachment listing.
- [ ] Tracker Status updated on week sheets only.

### 4.5 Risk register (lane-specific)

| Risk | Impact | Mitigation |
|---|---|---|
| Building separate mobile APIs that drift from web | Double maintenance | Shared services; mobile DTOs only when needed |
| Schema invented twice (web vs mobile) | Data corruption | One MSSQL script per ticket; API reads same tables |
| PackageEntryDetail reused for consult pay | Wrong ledger | Explicit PAY-03 rule |
| S4 money blocked by missing S3 appointment fields | Slip | APT payment columns before PAY |
| OTP/consent forks | Compliance gaps | Reuse SEC-06/07 |

  A Main Task is a whole FEATURE or capability the product needs.
  It is usually finished by SEVERAL Sub Tasks (UI + API + DB + QA).

  When the FULL main task is complete, end users can use that capability in UAT/production.

  A Main Task is a whole FEATURE or capability the product needs.

  Module context: Money for consultations: fee setup, online payment, cash payment, refunds, Paid/Unpaid status on appointments.
  In plain words: the product needs “Automatic payment verification — bank/webhook is source of truth, not the patient’s screen”.
  When the FULL main task is complete, end users can use that capability in UAT/production.

WHO WILL USE IT WHEN FINISHED?
  • Patients

SUB-TASKS THAT BELONG TO THIS MAIN TASK (siblings):
  (Your ticket is only ONE of these. Others may be done by teammates.)
  • PAY-02.01 [Web] — DB: PaymentOrder, PaymentEvent (raw webhook), idempotency key on payment_id
  • PAY-02.02 [Web] — Port Order/GenerateOrderId pattern to .NET 8; move keys to configuration; do not commit secrets
  • PAY-02.03 [Web] — Webhook handler payment.captured / payment.failed; signature verify; never trust client-only success
  • PAY-02.04 [QA] — QA: duplicate webhook; delayed webhook; failed capture; app closed mid-checkout

SUCCESS FOR THE MAIN TASK (big picture):
  All sibling sub-tasks above are Done (or formally Deferred with client note).
  Then the feature “Automatic payment verification — bank/webhook is source of truth, not the patient’s screen” works end-to-end on UAT.

  • PAY-02.04 [QA] — QA: duplicate webhook; delayed webhook; failed capture; app closed mid-checkout

### 7.4 Verification queries (useful after any sprint DB work)

```sql
-- Example: list new-ish tables (adjust filter)
SELECT t.name, SUM(p.rows) AS approx_rows
FROM sys.tables t
JOIN sys.partitions p ON p.object_id=t.object_id AND p.index_id IN (0,1)
WHERE t.name IN (
  'PasswordResetToken','ConsentRecord','OtpChallenge','AuditEvent','SecureDocument',
  'FamilyMember','CaregiverAuth','PaymentOrder','ConsultPayment','ErxSnapshot',
  'MedicineOrder','SupportTicket','TeleSession'
)
GROUP BY t.name
ORDER BY t.name;

-- Example: appointment money columns
SELECT COLUMN_NAME, DATA_TYPE
FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS
WHERE TABLE_NAME='PatientAppointment'
  AND COLUMN_NAME IN ('VisitType','ConsultMode','PaymentStatus','PaymentMethod','PayAtClinicAllowed',
                      'CancelReasonCode','CancelReasonText','CancelledBy','CancelledAt');
```

## 8. Approval gate

**No implementation from this document until you approve.** When you approve, say which slice to implement first, for example:

1. `S2 Database only`
2. `S2 Web API clinical subset`
3. `S3 APT DB + Web API`
4. `API Mobile PAT auth/booking wires`
5. `S4 PAY/FIN money spine`

Default recommended next slice after approval: **S2 Database verify/reuse + S2 Web API (clinical + website)** while Patient app API Mobile wires wait on frozen contracts.
